local function ApplyAndWait(plan)
 local A=ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption
 -- Refresh every existing unit immediately before absorption, before any AI turn.
 local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_EXPECT_V1'))
 e.Units={}
 for _,u in Players[plan.From]:GetUnits():Members() do e.Units[#e.Units+1]=A.SnapshotUnit(u) end
 Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_EXPECT_V1',e)
 for _,city in Players[plan.From]:GetCities():Members() do
  assert(next(A.CityAssets(city).Districts),'native district fixture absent')
 end
 local tx=A.Apply(plan)
 while tx.Status=='WAITING_UI' do
  Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_FIXTURE_UI_WAIT',{Kind='TRANSFER',ID=plan.ID})
  coroutine.yield('waiting for native transfer UI publication')
  tx=A.Resume(plan.ID)
 end
 local request=A.RequestVerification(plan.ID)
 if request then
  Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_FIXTURE_UI_WAIT',{Kind='VERIFY',ID=plan.ID})
  coroutine.yield('waiting for native verification UI publication')
 end
 return tx
end

end

JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_HANDLER=function()
 local p=JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE
 if p.Complete or p.Error then return end
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  if not p.Requested then
   if not Players[e.Owner]:IsTurnActive() then return end
   assert(not Players[e.Owner]:IsHuman() and not Players[1]:IsTurnActive(),'AI recall changed controller/turn')
   assert(Game.GetLocalPlayer()<0 or Game.GetLocalPlayer()==e.Owner,'another human command context')
   assert(Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra()>e.EraBefore,'global era boundary not processed')
   local origin=manager:GetHeroOriginCityID(e.Class)
   assert(manager:GetHeroClaimPlayer(e.Class)==e.Owner and origin.player==e.Owner and origin.id==e.CityID,'AI recall claim/origin changed')
   local city=assert(Players[e.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
   p.OriginX=city:GetX();p.OriginY=city:GetY()
   local allowed,results=CityManager.CanStartCommand(city,CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE,false,params,true)
   p.Query={OwnerActive=true,LocalPlayer=Game.GetLocalPlayer(),IsHuman=Players[e.Owner]:IsHuman(),Turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(),Era=Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra(),Allowed=allowed,Results=results}
   assert(allowed,'native recall not allowed on actual owner turn')
   p.CostBefore=city:GetGold():GetPurchaseCost(GameInfo.Yields.YIELD_FAITH.Index,native.Hash,MilitaryFormationTypes.STANDARD_MILITARY_FORMATION)
   p.FaithBefore=Players[e.Owner]:GetReligion():GetFaithBalance()
   p.LastFaith=p.FaithBefore
   assert(p.CostBefore>0 and p.FaithBefore>=p.CostBefore,'native AI recall cost/faith invalid')
   p.Requested=true
   trace('REQUEST',{Owner=e.Owner,City=origin.id,Class=e.Class,Cost=p.CostBefore,Faith=p.FaithBefore})
   CityManager.RequestCommand(city,CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE,params)
   print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_REQUEST] '..api.Canonical(p))
   return
  end
  for _,u in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
   if u:GetHeroClassType()==e.Class and not p.Existing[u:GetID()] then
    assert(not p.NewID,'multiple native recall candidates')
    p.NewID=u:GetID()
   end
  end
  if p.NewID then
   local origin=manager:GetHeroOriginCityID(e.Class)
   local city=assert(Players[e.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
   p.FaithAfter=Players[e.Owner]:GetReligion():GetFaithBalance()
   p.CostAfter=city:GetGold():GetPurchaseCost(GameInfo.Yields.YIELD_FAITH.Index,native.Hash,MilitaryFormationTypes.STANDARD_MILITARY_FORMATION)
   p.ClaimAfter=manager:GetHeroClaimPlayer(e.Class);p.OriginAfter=origin
   p.Complete=true
   print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_COMPLETE] '..api.Canonical(p))
  end
 end)
 if not ok then p.Error=tostring(err);print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PURCHASE_ERROR] '..p.Error) end
end
